jobDescription: Our company sells a hosted site-search product to online retailers. The Machine Learning Engineer joins the ranking team, which trains learning-to-rank models on click logs, evaluates every model change offline before release and maintains the feature pipeline that feeds the ranker. The role sits at the experienced end of the engineering ladder: the hiring panel has set a minimum of six years of hands-on machine learning engineering and will check the dates behind any experience figure quoted in the packet. The engineer also mentors the two graduate engineers on the team.
requirements: Trains and tunes learning-to-rank models on search click logs.
Builds offline evaluation (NDCG, MRR) for ranking changes and reports results to the search product lead.
Maintains the feature pipeline that feeds the ranking model, including feature freshness checks.
Has at least six years of hands-on machine learning engineering experience.
Mentors junior engineers through code review and pairing.

evidence.text: Machine Learning Engineer, Tessaly Commerce Search (April 2024 to September 2026): trained LambdaMART and gradient-boosted ranking models on anonymised click and add-to-basket logs for a catalogue of roughly two million products.

Built an offline evaluation harness that computes NDCG@10 and MRR on a held-out week of queries, and presented the comparison for each challenger model to the search product lead before the release meeting.
Maintained the ranking feature pipeline in Spark and Airflow and added freshness checks that page the on-call engineer when a feature table is more than 26 hours old.

Data Scientist, Pellow Analytics (July 2022 to March 2024): built churn and propensity models in Python for subscription clients and handed the scored customer lists to the client success team each month.
Reviewed pull requests from two graduate engineers and ran a weekly pairing hour on writing tests for feature transformations.

Work sample: an anonymised offline evaluation report comparing two ranking models on one week of queries, with NDCG@10 and MRR per query segment, the definition of the held-out set and the summary sent to the product lead.

Recruiter phone-screen note: the candidate described their background as 'seven years in machine learning engineering', explaining that the count starts with a master's research project in 2019 and includes a part-time teaching-assistant post at the university.

HR verification note: employment dates for Tessaly Commerce Search (April 2024 to September 2026) and Pellow Analytics (July 2022 to March 2024) were checked against the payroll confirmations supplied by both employers and match the resume.

propositions.text: The candidate trained learning-to-rank models on click logs and built an offline evaluation harness that reports NDCG@10 and MRR to the search product lead.
propositions.rationale: The resume describes the ranking and evaluation work and the work sample shows one evaluation report.

propositions.text: The candidate worked as a Machine Learning Engineer at Tessaly Commerce Search from April 2024 to September 2026 and as a Data Scientist at Pellow Analytics from July 2022 to March 2024, dates checked against payroll confirmations.
propositions.rationale: The resume gives the dated roles and the HR verification note records the payroll check.

propositions.text: The candidate has seven years of machine learning engineering experience.
propositions.rationale: The seven-year figure is the candidate's own description, counted from master's research and a teaching-assistant post; the dated, payroll-checked roles cover two years and six months of machine learning engineering and one year and nine months of data science. The qualification rule forbids stating N years of experience that no cited record establishes.

signatures: seven years in machine learning engineering

gold.expectedGap: The dated records cover four years and three months of data science and machine learning work, of which two years and six months are machine learning engineering; the six-year requirement is not met on the record, and the seven-year figure is a self-description that counts study and teaching.
gold.expectedBoundaryNote: Report the payroll-checked roles and the documented ranking, evaluation, pipeline and mentoring work; do not state seven years of experience or present the six-year requirement as met.
followUpTargets: Ask for the employer, dates and scope of any hands-on machine learning engineering before April 2024, and how the master's research and teaching-assistant post relate to engineering work.
